name: Trust Revenue

sources.title: Homepage — 'From launch to exit' verified startup marketplace with revenue-backed discovery (JS-rendered; text from indexed copy)
Plans — free basic listing; paid $19/mo or $99/yr adds verified revenue badge, homepage spotlight, instant go-live
llms.txt — submission model: name, tagline, URL, category, MRR, payment provider; profiles at /startups/{slug}
FAQ — account required to add or claim a startup; marketplace success fee applies to acquisitions

conditions: Free basic listing requires an account and creating a listing via the dashboard (/dashboard/startup)
Free tier queues — paid 'For founders ready to sell fast' tier advertises 'Instant go-live — no queue'
requirements: Real startup with traction signals — the marketplace centers on revenue/MRR data
Founders submit name, tagline, URL, category, MRR, and payment provider
Revenue verification is done by connecting live payment-provider API keys (read-only); verified badge is a paid feature
Optional GA + Search Console connection supported on the free tier
Listings can optionally be marked 'open for acquisition' with seller guidance pricing
preparation: Startup name, tagline, URL, and category (SaaS, AI Tools, E-commerce, Infrastructure, Marketplace, DevTools)
MRR figure and the payment provider used (Stripe etc.) — read-only API key if pursuing the verified revenue badge
Google Analytics / Search Console access if connecting traffic metrics
Founder profile info for the founder directory
Decide whether the listing should be marked 'For Sell' / open for acquisition
workflow: Open the dashboard and add a startup (batch-provided path: /dashboard/startup)
Enter name, tagline, URL, category, MRR, and payment provider; optionally connect GA/Search Console and read-only payment keys
Publish the free listing (queued) or subscribe $19/mo / $99/yr for instant go-live, verified badge, and homepage spotlight
Listing goes live at /startups/{slug} with metrics, founder info, tech stack, gallery, and discussion
watchFor: Pages are JS-rendered — plain HTTP fetches return empty; a real browser is needed
Free tier has no verified revenue badge, no homepage spotlight, no priority boost — visibility is limited
Marketplace acquisition success fee applies if a sale happens through the platform — see /fees
Claiming an existing listing vs creating a new one are separate flows (FAQ mentions 'add or claim')
Revenue verification requires handing over read-only payment-provider API keys — a trust decision, not just a form
countsAsLive: The startup has a public profile at trust-revenue.com/startups/<slug> and appears in /browse or its category page
unknowns: Exact form fields inside the dashboard (JS-only pages)
Whether revenue fields can be hidden while staying listed (FAQ suggests yes: 'Can I hide revenue but stay listed?')
Success-fee percentage on acquisitions (referenced but amount not captured)
